title: Compliance Memorandum — Good Faith Estimates and Billed-versus-Estimate Disputes, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Scope.** This memorandum applies to the Patient Financial Account on the financial class that requires a Good Faith Estimate (the Self-Pay Account).

**Delivery.** Where the class requires a Good Faith Estimate, the estimate is delivered within the class's short-lead delivery period, in business days, when the service is booked 3 to 9 business days ahead, and within its long-lead delivery period when the service is booked 10 or more business days ahead. It is recorded on the encounter's charges as their estimate amount.

**Eligibility for the dispute.** The billed total of an encounter is the sum of its charges less the self-pay discount adjustments applied to those charges. When the billed total exceeds the estimate by at least the class's dispute threshold, the patient may dispute the difference. A difference below the threshold, an encounter without an estimate, or an insured class (one that does not require an estimate) is not eligible, and the patient keeps the right to use the federal dispute process directly.

**Dispute window.** The dispute is started no later than the class's estimate-dispute window counted from the posting date of the first charge of the encounter. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after that posting date, and a dispute started on the last day still qualifies.

**Resolution.** The group resolves an eligible dispute by adjusting the encounter down to its estimate: one adjustment coded as an estimate-dispute adjustment, on the encounter's largest charge, equal to the billed total less the estimate.

### Worked cases (hypothetical figures, threshold 400.00, window 120 days)

| Estimate | Billed total | Difference | Started on day (first charge posted day 0) | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1200.00 | 1650.00 | 450.00 | 30 | eligible — adjustment of 450.00 on the largest charge |
| 1200.00 | 1600.00 | 400.00 | 120 | eligible — difference equals the threshold; last day of the window |
| 1200.00 | 1599.99 | 399.99 | 30 | not eligible — below the threshold |
| 1200.00 | 1650.00 | 450.00 | 121 | not eligible — outside the window |
| none | 900.00 | — | 10 | not eligible — no estimate |
